azurerm_kubernetes_cluster.aks enables managed Azure AD integration but has no ordering after null_resource.register_aks_msi_preview_feature, which registers and waits for the AAD-V2 feature used by this configuration. Make cluster creation wait for that registration provisioner to complete.

module.synapse_workspaces writes generated SQL credentials and workspace metadata to Key Vault, but unlike the other secret-writing modules it does not wait for module.keyvault_access_policies. Referencing the vault ID alone does not order these writes after the policies granting the deployment identity secret access; add this ordering when those policies provide that access.
